description: This file defines the AjaxBasePageNegotiator class, which manages theme negotiation for AJAX requests in Drupal, ensuring the correct theme is used and validating CSRF tokens.

classes.name: AjaxBasePageNegotiator
classes.description: Handles theme negotiation for AJAX requests, ensuring the correct theme is applied and CSRF tokens are validated.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AjaxBasePageNegotiator with CSRF generator, config factory, and request stack.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Determines if the negotiator applies to the current request based on AJAX page state.

methods.name: determineActiveTheme
methods.description: Determines and returns the active theme for the AJAX request after validating the CSRF token.
